scope: Relevant datasets, acquisition scripts, fragment source notes, source workbooks, reanalysis backups and ZIP member lists; .venv/tools dependencies, executable pickles and model checkpoints were not executed. Read-only inspection of original local files.
findings: Local Bhat copies have the same 31-column schema with no original-paper, trial, specimen or real experimental-series column.
The local acquisition source notes explicitly state no per-row original citations for Bhat; the class-based 99-row selection does not recover original experimental identities.

The 300-row JMEP_data_audit record worksheet is an uncompleted template: all verified flags=no, zero populated original-publication, condition, locator or interpolation-parent IDs. It is not source certification.
Aggregate source_record_mapping_v3 and legacy source labels concern different historical corpora and do not authenticate individual Bhat records.

The historical v3 builder merges minimum/typical standard values with experimental/digitized summaries, restores assumed inputs, and deduplicates rounded target/chemistry combinations. Its 675-row matrix is not accepted wholesale as primary measurements.
Some PDF-named local files are not parseable PDFs. File names alone were not treated as original-paper evidence.

Five additionally verified primary journal articles provide 78 directly reported condition summaries and 192 target values; two repeated table appearances are conservatively excluded. Together with 22 existing checked primary summaries, the separate Bhat-free cohort has 98 records.

The official Yuan 2024 supplement is byte-identical to the local workbook; 135 chemistry-screened records have original-study citations and 44 canonical publication groups. Original specimen IDs and extraction types are not certified for this compilation.
resolved_by_new_evidence: Known original-publication grouping and a primary-checked Bhat-free validation cohort, with literal original conditions and source locators. This permits source-resolved inference without attributing unknown Bhat identities.
not_recovered: The original study, real experimental-series and individual-specimen identities of Bhat rows. Numerical matches, downstream repository ownership and account access are not substitutes for the upstream collection ledger.

new_cohort_counts.scope: Separate Bhat-free diagnostic cohorts; no records are appended to the 188-record archival benchmark. Primary cohort includes its 22 existing primary entries, so it is not an external validation of that benchmark.
